results.title: TO THE JUSTICE OF THE PEACE PR...
results.description: To the Justice of the Peace Precinct 1, Palo Pinto County, Texas. We, the undersigned have obtained ten or more qualified votes of Justice of the Peace Precinct 1 Palo Pinto County, Texas, in accordance with the terms and provisions of the Texas Election Code, Title 17, hereby submit this our written application for a Petition for Local Option Election to Legalize the sale of malt-beverage and wine on and/or off premise. This is to be circulated among the qualified voters of such area for signatures of those qualified voters in the area who desire that a local options election be called in that area for the purpose of determining the following issue to wit: To legalize the sale of liquor, malt-beverage and wine on premise with a TABC Food and Beverage Certificate. It is the hope, purpose and intent of the applicant, GM Entertainment LLC, Gino Maurizio, to see legalized the sale of alcoholic beverages referred to in the issue set out above. Submitted to The Honorable Judge Todd Baker, Justice of Peace Precinct 1, Palo Pinto County, Texas on this 12th day of August, 2026.

results.title: 2027: Tension in Ebonyi as violence trails political meetings
results.description: There is palpable fear and anxiety in the Ezza controlled local governments in Ebonyi State following persistent attacks on residents by suspected political thugs. This year alone, the attack has left many residents of the areas injured with property worth millions of naira destroyed. Among the victims was a 40-year-old woman who claimed to have lost her four-month pregnancy in one of the attacks. The post 2027: Tension in Ebonyi as violence trails political meetings appeared first on The Sun Nigeria .
